item.title: When My DevSecOps Lab Started Consuming 95% CPU: A Practical Lesson in Container Resource Governance
item.description: A real incident from a local DevSecOps lab: while building a security-focused microservices environment on an 8 GB MacBook Air, my Docker + Kind Kubernetes cluster began consuming several CPU cores and multiple gigabytes of RAM. Instead of treating it as just a laptop performance problem, I used it as a lesson in resource governance, availability, container security, and DevSecOps engineering.
